$comment: Rule catalog — expected value. Standard 14, alongside edge. Kept in its own category because expected value is a monetary quantity and edge is a probability difference, and the whole point of the separation is that the two never share a home.

rules.title: Expected value is stated only with a stake and a payout
rules.description: A record stating an expected value also states the stake, the payout, and the currency.
rules.rationale: Expected value is the average return on a specific wager. Without a stake and a payout there is no wager, and the number is a probability or an edge that has been relabelled — which is exactly the confusion this pack separates structurally.
rules.remediation: Supply stake, payout, and currency, or remove the expected value.

rules.title: The stated expected value follows from the probability and the payout
rules.description: The stated expected value equals the probability times the net win, minus the complement times the stake, within the project's tolerance.
rules.rationale: Like edge, this is fully determined by numbers already in the record, so a mismatch is always a defect rather than a difference of opinion. The most common cause is treating the payout as the net win rather than the total return.
rules.remediation: Recompute as p*(payout - stake) - (1-p)*stake. Payout is the total returned on a win, stake included.
